types.name: polyester.api.v1.RequestErrorCode
types.doc:
RequestErrorCode identifies why the API refused a request before acting on
 it, whatever the procedure.

values.name: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE
values.doc:
The request is over the API's size limit, on the wire or once
 decompressed. Nothing was done. The same request is refused again, so do
 not retry it unchanged: send a smaller one.

types.name: polyester.api.v1.RequestErrorDetail
types.doc:
RequestErrorDetail is the error detail of a request every API refuses the
 same way, before any procedure-specific handling. A ConnectRPC, gRPC or
 gRPC-web error carries it with the code resource_exhausted for
 REQUEST_TOO_LARGE; a REST request gets HTTP 413 with the problem code
 REQUEST_TOO_LARGE instead.

fields.name: limit_bytes
fields.doc: The size limit the request is over, in bytes. Set for REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.
